description:
AnalyzeActivation reads a callee's ReturnType as it currently stands and is
subscribed to every revision, so a caller outside any cycle with its callee
re-runs on every rung of the callee's ascent. main/0 in
fixtures2/behavior/enum_take_drop_split.fz runs 49 times; in json_roundtrip, 59.

Paper (proposal page: ../fz-afu.4.html, artifact CKpR6FRLaMn5BXRuoMyBwn):

1. AnalyzeActivation reads a callee return through World::answer_use:
   Partner (the producer is the reader itself or waits on it) -> read current,
   the pair climbs together as today; Concluded -> read once; otherwise wait.
   The reader itself counts as a partner (direct recursion).
2. Unknown is not bottom. A call whose keying facts or return are being
   waited for yields an UNKNOWN value; the walk continues past it. Values
   computed from an unknown (call args, closure callee, any step via
   body::step_used_values/step_defined_values) are unknown; such callsites
   publish their edge unresolved. A dispatch on an unknown stops. Bottom (a
   partner's not-yet-risen return, or a concluded absent return = never
   returns) still ends the path. An unknown exists only in a run with waits,
   which cannot conclude.
3. pop_runnable corrections: a rebased job always runs (parking it on an
   answer its new body may never read left a stale construction target:
   callable_target_test); concluded_answers_missing also checks the job's
   standing waits (a satisfied wait can reopen before the job runs: 00181
   List.reduce/3).

Why this is not fz-229: partner-ness is the live wait graph (waits_reach), not
the static CallGraphComponent; Concluded is local, not Settled, and a
flickering conclusion costs a park, not a run.

Acceptance (measured on the probe against fz-afu.10 057e5ae5e):
- main/0 in enum_take_drop_split: 8 runs (5 by the paper; 3 are InputDemand
  re-keys owned by fz-afu.11). Tuple ladder main/0 21 -> 5.
- Census 2797 -> 2618; range_map Activation claims 74 -> 66; callee_replaced
  5 -> 4; fz2_cli aggregate 1239 -> 1236; json ladder Json.array_element/2
  16 revisions, not widened.
- Authorized raises (2026-09-26), each explained in its test comment:
  range_map DeriveCallGraphComponent 61/19 -> 64/22 (fz-afu.8's per-level
  walk, exposed by order); range_map reached_leaf_edit walks 9 -> 11 (rebased
  jobs run instead of parking); 00181 FormulaWork wakes 81 -> 83, blocked
  64 -> 78 (same 290 runs).
- A never-returning call's continuation is not compiled (spin example; final
  program identical to base).
- Final programs identical to base except json_roundtrip's now-exact returns.

Partial publication found by fz-xxd.10 revision 3 (2026-10-02; programs p1/s3 are quoted in fz-afu.13), the same defect seen from the publishing side: an analysis publishes its ReturnType while some call sites still wait, counting them as none.
- xxd10/a/p1.fz: select/2 calls wrap(&mailbox/2) and wrap(reducer). Under revision 3 the self-keyed row wrap(any) proceeds while wrap(fnref[mailbox/2]) waits for its keying facts; select publishes ReturnType rev 1 from one branch, main mints an Enum.reduce/3 activation from it, rev 2 mints another (3 activations where base has 2). The precise capture is subsumed by closure[wrap](any), so its work is found only later by runtime demand.
- xxd10/b/s/s3.fz: val's analysis publishes ReturnType while blocked on Recursive(arr/2); each piece of evidence arriving separately is a strict ascent, and each ascent mints a new item activation.
Added acceptance: in both cases a function publishes its return once per new evidence, never from a subset of call sites while the others wait; p1 mints 2 Enum.reduce/3 activations.
title: A caller reads each callee's return once it concludes, and walks past pending calls as unknown
